name: Classic cut
description: Scissors and clippers, shaped to your head and how you actually wear it.

name: Skin fade
description: A seamless fade down to the skin, blended by hand and finished with a razor line.

name: Scissor cut
description: All scissors, no clippers, for longer styles that need to move.

name: Buzz cut
description: One guard all over, cleaned up at the neck and ears.

name: Kids cut
description: For gentlemen under 12. Same care, smaller chair.

name: Hot towel shave
description: Hot towels, pre-shave oil, two passes with a straight razor, and a cold towel to close.

name: Beard trim & shape
description: Trimmed, shaped, and lined with a razor, finished with oil and balm.

name: Cut & beard
description: Any haircut plus a full beard trim and shape, in one sitting.

name: Head shave
description: A smooth straight-razor head shave with hot towels.

name: Line-up
description: Neck, edges, and hairline cleaned up between cuts.

name: Grey blending
description: A soft, natural tint that takes the edge off the grey, not all of it.

name: Scalp treatment
description: Exfoliating wash, massage, and a cooling tonic.
